description: email.rs:735-739: UTCDate::from(crate::helpers::now_utc_string().as_str()) is correct for RFC 8621 §5.5.3 receivedAt default. The civil_from_days implementation is correct (tests verify 9 known vectors) and avoids the chrono/time dependency. A contributor might suggest replacing with chrono — do not: this is intentional and tested.
title: Email/set create correctly defaults receivedAt to now
